historicalBoundary.scope: Re-read the Qin-collapse background; neither the household nor river encounter is attested. Original local dialogue, geography and witness claims do not establish historical military participation, precise dates or a companion's survival. No source-book text is published.

agentStoryReview.originality: Original SHI dialogue and rules; no media generation or third-party quotation.
agentStoryReview.continuity: The repaired roof, overturned basin, empty basket, keeper's record bag and previous trust state persist. A wrapped left shoe echoes a prior motif but is explicitly not identification of Ah Heng or anyone else.
agentStoryReview.dilemma: General messages expose a route but not names; a record permits more selective questioning at the cost of identifying disclosure. An unprompted account preserves independence but loses the guide; showing a record gains an introduction without pretending the guide's subsequent account is independent evidence.
agentStoryReview.corrections: Removed a pre-decision return promise from the household opening and removed narration implying every player retained identifying records. A promise or disclosure occurs only after explicit confirmation.
agentStoryReview.boundary: Agent review is not human emotional-resonance or final historical-material approval.

implementation.branches: Household and river scenes each offer two actions. Record-dependent actions require actual centrally held records. Both distributed and anonymized histories retain a non-identifying action; no dead end is introduced.
implementation.state: Carry food, debt, roof-promise state, local relationship and record custody. Record entrusted versus delivered and prompted versus unprompted evidence separately. Preserve uncertainty about missing people.
implementation.persistence: Separate fingerprinted branch slot, identifier-only save, reconstruction on load, rollback attempt on failure, no reaction before durable confirmation, duplicate and busy-navigation guards. Existing night and morning saves are unchanged.
implementation.scope: Development web only; no store submission or public deployment. Native SwiftUI/Unreal continuation parity remains unfinished.

verification.build: Production web build and size budgets pass; contact identifiers and story text are absent from release JavaScript/JSON. No public build was deployed.
verification.repository: npm run validate passed: 83 core tests and 349 web tests. Eight dedicated contact component tests exercise all four actions, reload, record restrictions, corrupt-save preservation, failed-save rollback, duplicate/busy-input guards and semantic accessibility. Existing real retreat/night/morning tests extend through contact.
verification.core: Actual retreat-to-night-to-morning entries exercise each available contact action and reject wrong-location or unavailable record actions. State preserves debts, resources, local relationship and promise; snapshot injection cannot invent evidence or reunions.
verification.visible: Corrected household leave-record and river ask-unprompted routes each pass 106 browser checks, with 31 captures and zero exceptions. Phone choice/reaction and restored desktop frames reviewed; contact, morning, night and retreat bytes survive cold reload. Other two contact actions have component coverage, not separate visible runs.
verification.superseded: Initial river capture at 05-00-13 predates the opening-text corrections and is not the accepted narrative evidence.
verification.boundary: Agent-driven web review, not physical-device, native, human listening/playtesting or final cinematic approval. All dedicated browser stacks stopped.

remaining: Resolve the promised sunset return, independent reed-bank inquiry and guided ferry introduction in later playable scenes.
Show actual consequences of information disclosure and allow recovery from broken trust rather than ending at descriptive state labels.
Human playtesting of pacing, emotional resonance, strategy balance and accessibility; native/device parity; reviewed cinematic and musical assets.
